tagline: 理光数码相机，2008 年发布
description: 理光于2008年推出的数码相机。配备11 elements in 7 groups。快门速度180, 120, 60, 30, 15, 8, 4, 2, 1–1/2000 seconds。

specs.重量: approx. 208g (excluding battery, SD memory card, and strap); about 30g more for the battery and strap
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh GX200 was introduced by Ricoh in 2008, as an evolution of the prize-winning Ricoh Caplio GX100.
